movesets.name: Nasty Plot
movesets.description:
With Nasty Plot, Galarian Moltres is a solid late-game setup sweeper and wallbreaker. Hurricane is the strongest Flying-type STAB option and can blow away Fighting-types like Iron Valiant, Great Tusk, and Zamazenta without requiring Galarian Moltres to Terastallize. If you would rather have something more consistent, Tera Blast Fairy can be useful as coverage against them while also hitting Dark-types like Ting-Lu harder than Hurricane, which, in combination with Fiery Wrath, allows Galarian Moltres to hit most of the tier at least neutrally. Taunt potentially turns it into a stallbreaker, as it blocks status moves like Whirlwind from Ting-Lu, Toxic from Gliscor and Clodsire, and Calm Mind and Soft-Boiled from Blissey, giving Galarian Moltres more opportunities to set up and sweep against bulkier teams, whereas with an Agility boost, Galarian Moltres matches up better against offensive teams, as it can outspeed threats like Iron Valiant, Dragapult, and Choice Scarf Enamorus, only remaining threatened by Raging Bolt's Thunderclap and other priority moves. Sitrus Berry is a must-have, allowing Galarian Moltres to potentially secure an extra boost from Berserk and its setup moves. Tera Ghost gives Galarian Moltres an immunity to Dragonite's Extreme Speed, Zamazenta's Body Press, and Blissey's Seismic Toss, as well as allowing it to double as a Rapid Spin blocker. Defensively, Tera Fairy is a solid typing that allows it to keep the resistance to Kingambit's Sucker Punch while making it immune to Dragpult's powerful Draco Meteor and Dragon Darts. Galarian Moltres typically runs maximum Special Attack and Speed to increase its sweeping potential. Alternatively, it can run a bulkier spread to give itself more chances to set up; this specific EV spread allows Galarian Moltres to outspeed uninvested Gliscor while surviving two Ivy Cudgels from Ogerpon-W after Sitrus Berry and two Ice Beams from Darkrai. This set can more safely run Taunt, whereas the more offensive set is better suited to running Agility for setting up.

Galarian Moltres fits best on hyper offensive teams. It pairs best with other offensive sweepers and wallbreakers similar to itself, such as Iron Valiant, Iron Moth, and Gholdengo, that can keep up pressure throughout a battle. Iron Valiant takes on foes like Darkrai and Raging Bolt, while Galarian Moltres handles Gholdengo and Pecharunt, forming a dangerous offensive core. Gholdengo can block any attempts to wear down Galarian Moltres with status and force damage on Ting-Lu and break through Fairy-types that Galarian Moltres struggles with. Iron Moth can help wallbreak and allow Galarian Moltres to sweep late in the game. Galarian Moltres can also fit well into Dark-type spam archetypes alongside teammates like Kingambit and Hisuian Samurott, breaking through bulkier foes like Kingambit and Tinkaton. Galarian Moltres, in return, can pressure Dark-resistant Pokemon like Zamazenta and Great Tusk. Galarian Moltres is particularly helped by entry hazards, the damage from which can chip down enemies that Galarian Moltres can then break through. Great Tusk and Iron Treads can set Stealth Rock to assist in this, use Rapid Spin to protect Galarian Moltres from entry hazard damage and let it setup on spinblockers, and check some of Galarian Moltres's tougher matchups like Raging Bolt and Iron Moth. Deoxys-S can also provide excellent support with entry hazards, while Hatterene can prevent opponents from setting their own hazards and can act as an additional setup sweeper for the team with Calm Mind. Sticky Web is also particularly helpful for Galarian Moltres. It allows it to sweep more of the tier by letting it outspeeding faster threats like Zamazenta and Iron Valiant without needing an additional boost from Agility, so Galarian Moltres can safely run Taunt instead; Araquanid and Ribombee are great teammates for this reason. Alolan Ninetales can facilitate another type of hyper offensive team; its Aurora Veil turns allow Galarian Moltres additional setup opportunities, especially when attempting to get a boost from both Nasty Plot and Agility back-to-back. Galarian Moltres is particularly susceptible to fast, powerful sweepers that can take it out before it has the chance to set up, including Iron Valiant and Zamazenta, and priority users like Raging Bolt and Dragonite that ignore its Agility boost. Pecharunt is an excellent teammate to take these hits and threaten back with Nasty Plot-boosted Malignant Chains; this can help overwhelm foes like Ting-Lu with poison, as well as Fairy-types that threaten Galarian Moltres like Iron Valiant and Clefable. Bulkier Pokemon that can spread Toxic like Gliscor and Clodsire can cut off Galarian Moltres's sweeping potential should it opt to forego Taunt; Kyurem is a strong teammate that can break through these checks. Other offensive teammates that form solid pairings with Galarian Moltres are Dragonite, which Galarian Moltres can help sweep by taking out Gholdengo, Zamazenta to deal with Kingambit while Galarian Moltres deals with Ghost-types in return, and Ogerpon-W, which can break through bulkier teams if Galarian Moltres is running Agility.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot (Flying)
movesets.description:
Galarian Moltres is a powerful special attacker on Flying teams that keeps Ghost- and Psychic-type threats in check thanks to its access to Nasty Plot. Fiery Wrath serves as a way for it to deal damage and take down Ghost-types such as Dragapult and Gholdengo. Hurricane provides Galarian Moltres with a way to deal significant damage to foes like Zamazenta, Volcarona, and the Ogerpon formes, except Ogerpon-C. However, due to Hurricane's low accuracy, Substitute can be be used in place of it to protect Galarian Moltres from status conditions, such as Toxic from Toxapex and Clodsire. Agility lets Galarian Moltres outspeed threats like Latios and Gholdengo. Alternatively, Pain Split lets it recover and allows it to activate its Berserk ability to get multiple Special Attack boosts.

Skarmory is a great partner for Galarian Moltres, as it is a physical wall that can switch into Rock- and Ice-type moves from foes such as Iron Boulder, Kleavor, and Weavile. Corviknight removes entry hazards using Defog in case Galarian Moltres's Heavy-Duty Boots get removed; specially defensive Corviknight provides Galarian Moltres a safe switch-in to Ice-types moves such as Ice Beam and Freeze-Dry from foes like Kyurem, Greninja, and Alolan Ninetales. Gliscor pairs well with Galarian Moltres, as it is immune to Electric-type moves, and it can switch into Knock Off to hinder any attempt to remove Galarian Moltres's Heavy-Duty Boots, provided that it's already poisoned. Additionally, Gliscor can switch into Rock-type attacks from foes like Iron Boulder and Hisuian Arcanine and hit them back with Earthquake. The Landorus formes form an offensive core with Galarian Moltres by removing threats like Empoleon and Gouging Fire. Enamorus revenge kills Rock-types that beat Galarian Moltres such as Tyranitar, Kleavor, and Hisuian Arcanine with Superpower and Earth Power, along with providing Healing Wish support. Articuno synergizes well with Galarian Moltres, as Articuno serves as a special wall and Galarian Moltres serves as a special attacker, forming a special core that exterminates foes like Greninja, Landorus, Clodsire, and Spectrier. Zapdos provides Galarian Moltres a safe switch-in to Electric-type attacks and can paralyze Pokemon that make contact with it due to Static. It also acts as a pivot thanks to Volt Switch, allowing Galarian Moltres to come in safely. Galarian Moltres is greatly assisted by Nasty Plot Tornadus-T due to its ability to remove Steel-type threats like Hisuian Goodra, Heatran, and Archaludon with Focus Blast. Assault Vest Tornadus-T can switch into attacks like Thunderbolt and Power Gem from foes like Iron Valiant, Flutter Mane, and Heatran and subsequently use U-turn to bring Galarian Moltres in safely. Dragonite forms an offensive core with Galarian Moltres, as Dragonite acts as a physical setup sweeper taking out foes like Alolan Muk, Corviknight, Clodsire, and Toxapex, while Galarian Moltres acts as a special setup sweeper taking out foes such as Dragapult and Latios. Dragonite finishes off enemies weakened by Galarian Moltres with Extreme Speed.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot (Dark)
movesets.description:
With its respectable bulk, access to Nasty Plot and Agility, and a great ability in Berserk to further bolster its offensive prowess, Galarian Moltres makes for an incredible wallbreaker and setup sweeper for Dark teams, threatening Fighting- and Bug-types like Scrafty and Volcarona. Hurricane OHKOes Fighting-types like Iron Valiant, Urshifu-R, and, when at +2, Assault Vest Gallade. It is also Galarian Moltres's strongest option for hitting Fairy-types, outright OHKOing Flutter Mane and Hatterene at +2 and OHKOing non-Assault Vest Primarina at +2 after minimal chip damage. Fiery Wrath is a more reliable STAB option, hitting Flying-resistant Pokemon like Heatran, Corviknight, and Zapdos. Agility allows Galarian Moltres to mitigate its low Speed, allowing it to outspeed would-be faster foes like Flutter Mane and Choice Scarf users like Iron Valiant.

Ting-Lu provides entry hazard support and leverages its Electric immunity and Rock resistance to handle foes like Raging Bolt and Tyranitar. It can also break through special walls like Clodsire, Hisuian Goodra, and Alolan Muk. Grimmsnarl provides dual screens support for easier setup, potentially letting Galarian Moltres survive super effective moves like Iron Valiant's Moonblast and Iron Hands's Thunder Punch to activate both Berserk and its Weakness Policy. Grimmsnarl can also use Taunt to deny hazards from being set up and provide safe a switch in to Galarian Moltres using Parting Shot. Alolan Muk, with its Poison typing and excellent special bulk, can stave off Fairy-type attacks from foes like Choice Specs Flutter Mane and Choice Scarf Enamorus, threatening them back with Poison Jab. Bisharp serves an offensive answer to Fairy-, Ice-, and Rock-types, utilizing Sucker Punch to pick off Flutter Mane and Iron Boulder. Choice Band Meowscarada, Choice Specs Greninja, and Swords Dance Weavile can eliminate bulky Ground-types like Clodsire and Ting-Lu. Meowscarada and Greninja can help alleviate the Rock matchup for Galarian Moltres, with Meowscarada also threatening Water-types like Primarina and Dondozo. Meowscarada, Hoopa-U, and Weavile eliminate special walls like Blissey and Hisuian Goodra; Hoopa-U and Greninja also assist in Fighting and Fairy matchups. Sableye, with the combination of Will-O-Wisp and Knock Off, can wither down foes like Iron Hands and Dragonite, making it easier for Galarian Moltres to set up and eliminate them. Mandibuzz serves as a Defogger and can provide safe entry to Galarian Moltres using U-turn. Choice Scarf Darkrai can use its superb Speed tier and coverage options to revenge kill opposing Choice Scarf users like Iron Boulder, Meowscarada, and Greninja.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot
movesets.description: The speed investment allows Moltres-G to outspeed Max Speed Booster Energy Gouging Fire and Choice Scarf Landorus-T in Tailwind.

strategies.overview:
• Galarian Moltres has a very unique role in this format as an incredibly bulky and consistent spread attacker. It struggles to pick up OHKOs even with Choice Specs, but it can output a lot of spread damage with Fiery Wrath and win damage trades against most Pokemon, such as the Ogerpon formes, Rillaboom, Landorus and Iron Crown. Galarian Moltres fares very well against specially offensive cores, such as those featuring Iron Crown, or slower-paced teams, like Porygon2 compositions.

  • Galarian Moltres's biggest check is Flutter Mane, which can hit it very hard with Moonblast and is specially bulky enough to survive any of its STAB attacks. Galarian Moltres can also struggle to deal with Raging Bolt, especially with Assault Vest, as it is one of the few special attackers that is able to trade more damage against Galarian Moltres. If not positioned correctly, Galarian Moltres can have issues with physical attackers due to its average Defense stat. A notable one is Chien-Pao, which resists Galarian Moltres's spread moves and can threaten an OHKO back with Icicle Crash.

  • Galarian Moltres pairs very well with bulky support Flutter Mane, as it can paralyze opposing threats with Thunder Wave, letting Galarian Moltres outspeed them in a lot of scenarios, and use Moonblast to deal with some of Galarian Moltres's checks, such as Raging Bolt and Chien-Pao. Its Thunder Wave has the added potential of putting odds in your favor with the combined factors of full paralysis and Fiery Wrath's flinch chance. Flutter Mane can also use Taunt to prevent setup from Pokemon like Raging Bolt with Calm Mind. Ogerpon-W is another strong partner, redirecting attacks from Galarian Moltres and allowing it to keep dealing damage. Lastly, Sneasler has amazing type synergy with Galarian Moltres, dealing with the Fairy- and Dark-types that it can have issues hitting, and helps it get into position with Fake Out.

movesets.name: Bulky Spread Attacker
movesets.description:
• Choice Specs Galarian Moltres is amazing at spreading damage across the opposing team, being able to heavily damage most Pokemon in the format.

  • With Tera Dark's boost, Dark Pulse is a strong option against rain-centered teams, as it can bypass Pelipper's Wide Guard and 2HKO Archaludon. It is also strong and the most damaging option against Dondozo after Commander has been activated. Tera Blast Steel allows Galarian Moltres to threaten Fairy- and Ice-types such as Flutter Mane, Chien-Pao, and Articuno. Air Slash allows it to pick up OHKOs against common threats such as the Urshifu and Ogerpon formes. Snarl allows it to control damage when facing two opposing special attackers.

  • Because of its ability Berserk, Galarian Moltres gets the most value out when its below half HP, so a bulky EV spread fits it very well. The given spread allows it to survive attacks such as Tera Stellar Sacred Sword from Chien-Pao when Galarian Moltres is Terastallized, Choice Band Close Combat from both Urshifu formes, and Sword of Ruin-boosted Mystic Water Surging Strikes from Urshifu-R.

  • Tera Dark allows Fiery Wrath to 2HKO most Pokemon in the format, such as the Ogerpon and Ursaluna formes, while Tera Steel helps with Flutter Mane, Articuno, Ogerpon-C, and Chien-Pao by turning Galarian Moltres's weaknesses into resistances and allowing it to hit them super effectively with Tera Blast.

movesets.name: Black Glasses
movesets.description:
Galarian Moltres utilizes its great bulk, typing, and movepool to become a great offensive support Pokemon that can also beat the powerful Calyrex formes. Fiery Wrath provides a consistent spread STAB option paired with its chance to flinch, complimenting Galarian Moltres's bulk as a great tool to rack up damage. Foul Play on the other hand is a great anti-physical attacker tool, giving Galarian Moltres a fairly good matchup into Calyrex-I. Tailwind gives Galarian Moltres a supportive role in providing speed control for its team, allowing it to outspeed and fire off Fiery Wraths and Foul Plays. Black Glasses helps boost Galarian Moltres's damage output even more, allowing it to OHKO Calyrex-S and pairing well with potential Berserk boosts. The Speed investment allows Galarian Moltres to outspeed Choice Scarf Urshifu-R with Tailwind active, as well as naturally outspeeding most Gholdengo. The defensive investment allows Galarian Moltres to have a good chance of surviving a +2 Tera Fairy-boosted Draining Kiss from Calyrex-S or a Flare Blitz from non-Tera Fire Koraidon. Tera Dark sheds Galarian Moltres's Ice and Electric weaknesses, and the increased damage to its Dark-type STAB moves allow it to threaten an OHKO on Calyrex-I.

Galarian Moltres typically struggles against Pokemon that can reliably win the damage trade versus it like Raging Bolt and Zamazenta-C. Amoonguss is able to comfortably tank Galarian Moltres's attacks and retaliate with Spore. Miraidon and Urshifu-R are also problematic matchups for Galarian Moltres, as Miraidon is able to outspeed and OHKO it, while Urshifu-R takes minimal damage from Galarian Moltres and can hit it in return with a Surging Strikes. While Zamazenta-C is is a great check against Galarian Moltres, it is also an amazing partner. Galarian Moltres gives it speed control and strong super effective damage against the Ghost-types Zamazenta-C would typically struggle against while Zamazenta-C grants Wide Guard support for Galarian Moltres, allowing it to effectively counter Calyrex-I. Fairy-types that would try to counter Galarian Moltres like Flutter Mane and Tera Fairy Calyrex-S are also covered by Zamazenta-C's Heavy Slam. Rillaboom is able to deal with opposing Urshifu-R trying to take advantage of their Dark resistance, as well as overriding Electric Terrain from Miraidon and threatening an OHKO with Choice Band-boosted High Horsepower.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 4 onwards

Price Range: 9-10 points

Overview: Galarian Moltres is a fearsome sweeper thanks to its fantastic offensive typing, bulk, and ability Berserk. Its offensive STAB combination offers near-unresisted coverage, with few Pokemon able to stand up to it defensively. Terastallization bolsters its sweeping potential even further, with Tera Blast coverage allowing it to muscle past almost any foe it desires. While Galarian Moltres's sweeping capabilities are great, its Speed and Special Attack are both rather unimpressive before boosts, leaving it unable to break healthy foes and outsped by faster threats before setting up. Because it often needs to run both Nasty Plot and Agility, it rarely has room to carry Taunt and is vulnerable to being phazed. Despite these drawbacks, Galarian Moltres is still an incredibly dangerous sweeper that should be considered when drafting your team.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Setup Sweeper: Nasty Plot and Agility allow Galarian Moltres to significantly increase its damage output and outspeed nearly all of its foes, subsequently sweeping opposing teams with Fiery Wrath and Hurricane or Air Slash.

Defensive Pivot: Galarian Moltres can also leverage its huge special bulk to switch into and check attackers, fighting back with its STAB moves or pivoting out to a teammate with U-turn to handle the threat.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Fiery Wrath, Hurricane, Air Slash

Setup Moves: Nasty Plot, Agility

Utility Moves: Foul Play, Sucker Punch, Snarl, Taunt, U-turn, Rest, Memento

Coverage: Tera Blast, Shadow Ball, Ancient Power

Niche Moves

Pain Split: Galarian Moltres can use Pain Split to recover health against bulkier foes and potentially trigger Berserk additional times.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Galarian Moltres appreciates being as healthy as possible before it sets up, and Heavy-Duty Boots allows it to switch in when Stealth Rock is up without taking damage.

Weakness Policy: Thanks to Galarian Moltres's massive bulk, it can often take a super effective attack and survive, allowing it to trigger Weakness Policy in addition to Berserk, granting it many stat boosts in a single turn to sweep teams with.

Chesto Berry / Sitrus Berry: Berries that let it recover HP, whether indirectly through enabling Rest or directly through healing, allow Galarian Moltres to trigger Berserk, recover damage, and then potentially trigger Berserk a second time to substantially increase its damage output.

Niche Items

Damage-boosting Items: Black Glasses or Sharp Beak can be effective if they help Galarian Moltres secure additional KOs it otherwise couldn't.

Assault Vest: Using its massive Special Defense stat, Galarian Moltres can utilize an Assault Vest to check opposing dangerous special attackers.

Resistance Berries: Resistance Berries can help Galarian Moltres tank a super effective hit to allow it to set up for a sweep.

Tera

Galarian Moltres makes a fantastic Tera Captain thanks to its great bulk, with Tera granting it more opportunities to set up. Tera Fairy and Fighting are good options that shift its resistances to this effect and additionally allow it to break down foes like Dark-types coming in to check its Fiery Wrath. When its STAB moves need more power, Tera Dark and Flying are great offensive options that boost Fiery Wrath and Hurricane, respectively. It should be noted that while Galarian Moltres is excellent as a Tera Captain, making it one means you will likely be unable to afford a higher-tier Tera Captain and will need to pair it with another mid- or low-tier Captain as a result.

Draft Strategy

Galarian Moltres fits well on teams in need of its sweeping potential. While considering one's draft selections, it should be noted that Galarian Moltres offers nearly zero utility to teams and demands adequate support to facilitate its sweeping capabilities.

Entry Hazard Control: Entry hazards contribute strongly to Galarian Moltres's sweeping capabilities, allowing it to dispatch threats sooner than it could otherwise when they are weakened by hazards. Additionally, it strongly appreciates Stealth Rock removal from its own side of the field freeing it up to use items other than Heavy-Duty Boots. Entry hazard setters like Sandy Shocks and Gliscor provide Stealth Rock and Spikes, which Galarian Moltres enjoys, and partners like Great Tusk and Iron Treads make great teammates for their ability to remove hazards with Rapid Spin in addition to providing Stealth Rock.

Wallbreakers: Wallbreakers help break open teams to assist Galarian Moltres in sweeping. Physical attackers make good partners, as they wear down its checks and encourage physical bulk investment from foes. Partners like Palafin, Ursaluna, and Baxcalibur make good teammates, as they are capable of punching holes in opposing teams quickly.

Pivots: Galarian Moltres enjoys being positioned well to give it time to set up Nasty Plot or Agility. Pivots to help bring it in safely make good partners, as a slow Volt Switch or U-turn allows it to get on the field in front of a foe it can set up on. Rotom-W, Scizor, and Galarian Slowking make great partners, as they are able to use their pivoting moves to bring in Galarian Moltres safely.

Dual Screens: While not a necessity, Galarian Moltres makes great use of dual screens support, further strengthening its ability to set up and use a Weakness Policy to facilitate a sweep. Dual screens setters such as Klefki, Tinkaton, and Uxie can fill this role with ease.

Checks and Counters

Specially Bulky Pokemon: Specially bulky checks that can sponge Galarian Moltres's STAB moves are a nuisance; where foes like Rotom-W, Tyranitar, and Ting-Lu utilize their bulk to annoy it.

Phazing: While Galarian Moltres can carry Taunt, it often does not have the moveslots available for it and is therefore vulnerable to phazing moves stopping its sweep in its tracks.

Fast Physical Attackers: Galarian Moltres's average physical bulk and Speed make it vulnerable to being KOed before it has time to move. Foes like Palafin, Ogerpon-W, and Sneasler can either outright KO it or deal tremendous damage to it very quickly.

movesets.name: Double Dance
movesets.description:
Galarian Moltres leverages Nasty Plot and Agility alongside a good STAB combination to become a fearsome setup sweeper that can break through special walls. Agility allows Galarian Moltres to outspeed the entire unboosted metagame, and 208 Speed EVs let it outspeed Pokemon with base Speed of 110 such as Ogerpon-W and Iron Moth at +1. Sitrus Berry synergizes extremely well with Berserk, providing recovery in the middle of a sweep and potentially allowing Berserk to activate twice. Meanwhile, Tera Steel greatly improves Galarian Moltres's defensive profile by turning its Fairy-, Ice-, and Rock-type weaknesses, such as attacks from Zacian-C and Kyurem-White, into resistances while also helping it withstand priority moves like Extreme Speed from Arceus.

Galarian Moltres is essentially exclusive to hyper offense, fitting best on Aurora Veil and dual screens teams, where it can find more opportunities to set up safely. It relies on Gods that donate high Special Attack, such as Kyurem-White or Mewtwo, to enable it to sweep effectively. However, it can still struggle against the likes of Ho-Oh and Unaware Dondozo, so it can be used either as a late-game sweeper after these checks have been chipped or as a way to soften them for teammates such as Polteageist and Mewtwo. Additionally, as Galarian Moltres is vulnerable to Stealth Rock, it appreciates teammates that provide entry hazard control, such as Magic Bounce Hatterene, Rapid Spin Great Tusk, and Mortal Spin Glimmora.

movesets.name: Custap Berry
movesets.description:
• Galarian Moltres uses its Custap Berry to win matchups against faster Pokemon.
  • Nasty Plot should be used to counter foes that set up against Galarian Moltres like Corviknight, Pecharunt, and Cresselia, as well as foes that may hold Weakness Policy, such as Metagross.
  • Endure enables Galarian Moltres to survive a lethal hit and activate its Custap Berry, allowing it to beat Pokemon like Meowscarada, Chien-Pao, and Custap Berry Skeledirge.
  • The defensive EVs allow Galarian Moltres to survive an Outrage from Choice Band Adamant Haxorus while also taking a Hyper Beam from Modest Porygon-Z.
  • Galarian Moltres struggles to beat specially bulky Pokemon such as Ursaluna and Assault Vest Hoopa-U, as well as Pokemon that resist its moves like Primarina, Raging Bolt, and Hisuian Goodra. Therefore, pairing it with Pokemon that can beat these threats such as Meowscarada, Corviknight, and Ogerpon-W will be beneficial.

movesets.name: Weakness Policy
movesets.description:
• Fiery Wrath lets Galarian Moltres easily clean up Ghost- and Psychic-type foes such as Spectrier, Cresselia, and Iron Crown.
  • Hurricane enables Galarian Moltres to handle Fighting- and Grass-type Pokemon like Great Tusk, Ogerpon-W, and Iron Valiant.
  • Nasty Plot allows Galarian Moltres to boost its Special Attack in order to compete with threats such as Take Heart Manaphy and specially defensive, Weakness Policy Iron Crown; it also lets it remove foes that are not OHKOed such as Pecharunt.
  • Air Slash gives Galarian Moltres a second STAB option for the Encore + Disable Iron Valiant matchup while also providing a more reliable way to hit foes. Alternatively, Taunt can be used to disrupt foes such as Ogerpon-W, Weakness Policy Iron Crown, and Serperior.
  • The EV spread allows Galarian Moltres to survive Spirit Break from Jolly Choice Band Iron Valiant and Moonblast from Timid Choice Specs Iron Valiant.
  • Pair Galarian Moltres with Ground-types like Great Tusk, which covers its Electric weakness, protecting it from threats like Raging Bolt while also checking foes such as Choice Band Ursaluna and Tyranitar. In return, it checks Great Tusk answers like Ogerpon-W and Serperior. Steel-types like Iron Crown and Metagross are also good partners for Galarian Moltres, backing its Fairy weakness and checking foes such as Sylveon and Alolan Ninetales. In exchange, Galarian Moltres checks threats to these Steel-types such as Spectrier and Volcarona.

movesets.name: Assault Vest
movesets.description:
• Assault Vest allows Galarian Moltres to win matchups against strong special attackers, like Volcanion and Iron Crown.
  • Hurricane is Galarian Moltres's main Flying-type STAB move, hitting Grass-types like Ogergon-W and Fighting-types like both Urshifu formes.
  • Fiery Wrath enables Galarian Moltres to beat Pokemon such as Iron Crown, Pecharunt, and Cresselia.
  • Air Slash allows Galarian Moltres to beat Encore + Disable Iron Valiant, and is more accurate, letting it break Sneasler's and Volcarona's Substitute more reliably.
  • Sucker Punch allows it to win against Custap Berry users like Urshifu-S and Skeledirge, as well as Liechi Berry Sneasler.
  • The EV spread lets Galarian Moltres survive Modest Choice Specs Porygon-Z Hyper Beam as well as Choice Band Haxorus Outrage.
  • Galarian Moltres struggles to beat bulky Fairy- and Steel-types like Sylveon, Primarina, Corviknight, and Registeel as well as Electric-types like Iron Hands. Thus, Steel-types like Iron Crown and Metagross, Ground-types like Ursaluna and Landorus-T, and Fire-types like Volcanion and Volcarona are good partners for it.

movesets.name: Nasty Plot
movesets.description: Leveraging its excellent defensive profile and bulk, on top of its access to a multitude of boosting moves, Galarian Moltres makes for an excellent mid-to late-game cleaner on more offensive teams. It provides an important buffer against offensive threats such as Aegislash and Alakazam while also finding setup opportunities against a large portion of defensive staples, such as Slowbro and Mega Venusaur. Nasty Plot boosts Galarian Moltres's Special Attack to absurd levels, allowing it to reliably pressure specially defensive tanks such Hippowdon and Clefable. Agility allows Galarian Moltres to outspeed common revenge killers such as Mega Aerodactyl and Choice Scarf Enamorus after one round of setup while giving it the opportunity to clean up opposing teams late-game when its wallbreaking prowess with Nasty Plot isn't as necessary. Taunt, on the other hand, can be used to prevent status and healing from Pokemon such as Blissey and specially defensive Hippowdon, allowing Galarian Moltres to wear them down or use them as setup fodder. Hurricane, in conjunction with Flyinium Z, gives Galarian Moltres a powerful one-time nuke in Supersonic Skystrike that can break through neutral targets such as Blissey and Gastrodon, threatening to outright OHKO the latter at +2 while also offsetting Hurricane’s middling accuracy in the process. As Galarian Moltres can struggle to safely find setup opportunities against faster threats such as Mega Aerodactyl and Enamorus, it pairs best with offensive teammates that can also complement its wallbreaking prowess; late-game cleaners such as Swords Dance Aegislash and Booster Energy Iron Moth capitalize on Galarian Moltres's ability to weaken specific answers, such as Unaware Clefable and Skeledirge, respectively, allowing them to sweep opposing teams with greater ease late-game. The latter can also invite in and weaken Rock-types such as Tyranitar, which Galarian Moltres can struggle to break through otherwise. Galarian Moltres's Stealth Rock weakness and inability to run Heavy-Duty Boots necessitates strong anti-hazard options, leads such as Excadrill and Mew can all shut down common entry hazard setters, the former via Rapid Spin and the latter via Taunt.

movesets.name: Double Dance (Dark)
movesets.description: With access to both Nasty Plot and Agility as well as a Special Attack-boosting ability in Berserk, Galarian Moltres is a great late-game sweeper for Dark teams. In addition, its part-Flying typing provides Dark teams with a great offensive option against Fighting and Bug teams, as well as a greatly appreciated neutrality to the aforementioned types. After one Nasty Plot boost, Galarian Moltres 2HKOes physically defensive Toxapex, physically defensive Ting-Lu, and Celesteela. After one Agility boost, it is able to outspeed would-be faster Pokemon such as Choice Scarf Iron Valiant, Regieleki, and +1 Volcarona, as well as Mega Swampert in rain. With Flyinium Z , a Nasty Plot-boosted Supersonic Skystrike OHKOes Mega Diancie, Tapu Koko, and specially defensive Toxapex. An unboosted Supersonic Skystrike is still able to OHKO Terrakion after Stealth Rock damage. Hisuian Samurott provides entry hazard support in order to wear down incoming foes into OHKO range for Galarian Moltres, and in return, Galarian Moltres can threaten the Grass- and Fighting-types the two of them struggle with such as Mega Venusaur and Urshifu-R. Grimmsnarl is another great teammate, as it is able to set up dual screens to further make Galarian Moltres difficult to KO, and it can also run Taunt to prevent Stealth Rock from being set. Because of Galarian Moltres's part-Flying-typing, it is vulnerable to Stealth Rock. Because of this vulnerability, it appreciates hazard control from Mega Sableye's Magic Bounce, and Mega Sableye is also able to cripple opposing foes with Will-O-Wisp and Knock Off. Choice Band users such as Weavile, Roaring Moon, and Meowscarada can check walls Galarian Moltres struggles with like Dondozo and Clodsire. In return, Meowscarada and Weavile appreciate Galarian Moltres matching up well against Volcarona and Roaring Moon appreciates Galarian Moltres matching up well against Great Tusk. Lastly, Galarian Moltres can be paired with other sweepers such as Swords Dance Weavile and Dragon Dance Roaring Moon to soften each other's checks to enable each other to sweep. For example, Weavile is able to threaten Ting-Lu and Clodsire, while Galarian Moltres is able to handle Choice Scarf Gholdengo in return. When Galarian Moltres is not able to complete an outright sweep, it can set up for Choice Scarf users such as Meowscarada and Greninja to clean up.
